newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks open slightly higher, Peugeot slips.
newsitem.headline: French stocks open slightly higher, Peugeot slips.

text.p: French shares opened slightly higher on Thursday but immediately gave up gains to trade weaker while Peugeot skidded by over two percent.
Dealers said the market was very quiet and there was no fundamental movement either way, waiting for the return of normal business next year.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index opened 0.02 percent higher but was down 0.77 points or 0.03 percent at 2,288.78 at 0904 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was up three at 2,290.
"There is really nothing happening," said a broker, adding there were no stories about Peugeot in the market.
"In a market as quiet as today you quickly get big swings in prices," the trader added.
Tobacco group Seita was down 1.73 percent at 216.20 francs. Liberation newspaper said that a second civil suit had been lodged by a lawyer for the family of a smoker who had died.
A block trade of 1.036 million shares in the Union Pour Le Financement de l'Immeuble de Societes (UIS) took place at 170 francs per share immediately after the opening.
This would represent seven percent of the share capital, a dealer said.

At UIS, nobody was immediately available to comment on the transaction. UIS is indirectly controlled by insurer GAN , which has 13.39 percent via its Gan Incendie Accidents unit, 29.55 percent through GAN Vie and 40.17 percent via UIC.
